dialogues.speaker: Fyodor
dialogues.text: Ilya! Well, this is a surprise. Long time no see, old classmate. We both went off and built our own lives, and now here we are, running into each other at the station! How are you these days?

dialogues.speaker: Ilya
dialogues.text: Oh... Fyodor. It's been, what, ten years? You seem to be doing well.

dialogues.speaker: Fyodor
dialogues.text: I am, I am! I've got a post with the Veche now. Not a seat of my own, but it's still enough for me to know the right people and be known by them.

dialogues.speaker: Fyodor
dialogues.text: In fact, I'm here today to see off one of the deputies on an inspection trip. Personally, no less. That should tell you they see me as someone dependable. Give it a few more years, and who knows? They might just promote me straight to the Veche...

dialogues.speaker: Fyodor
dialogues.text: But listen to me, going on about myself. How have you been, Ilya?

dialogues.speaker: Fyodor
dialogues.text: You look like you just came back from somewhere. Planning to find a post here in Snezhnograd? Well, if there's anything your old classmate here can help with, don't be shy. Just say the word!

dialogues.speaker: Ilya
dialogues.text: Heh... Still quick on the uptake I see, old friend. Yes, I've just been transferred back to Snezhnograd, and I'm now on my way to report to the Lord Rooster.

dialogues.speaker: Fyodor
dialogues.text: T-t-the Lord Rooster? Then you must be... no, forgive me, sir. You must be on the Veche then...?

dialogues.speaker: Ilya
dialogues.text: Heh, it's not as big a deal as you make it out to be, old friend. All I can do is put in a word here and there. If anything, I'll be relying on you to look after me at the Veche.

dialogues.speaker: Fyodor
dialogues.text: Oh, no, no, old friend... no, sir, please. You're far too modest. I've always known you were different than the rest of us, even back then. You always had a certain air about you!

dialogues.speaker: Fyodor
dialogues.text: To think I'd run into you here, what luck! Sir, when you have a moment, I'd be grateful for any guidance you could spare...
